verdict.rule: SPEC.md: X0 on 3m holds up on market m only if (a) TradingView 2025-05-01..2026-10-01 n >= 100 and PF >= 1.15, (b) PF > 1 in 2025 and in 2026, (c) PF above C-REV, C-RND seed 1 and C-LONG on the same chart, (d) local 2021-02-01..2025-05-30 PF > 1, (e) fewer than 1/60 of 1,000 random-side seeds reach X0's local net. Holds up overall = at least one market passes all five. ES (no local data) can at most be 'holds up on TradingView only (provisional)', which needs (a)-(c) plus PF > 1 on X0-OOW. Other timeframes and variants are leads, never passes.
